questions.question: Which environment are you testing the hook integration in?

options.label: Local dev
options.description: Running hooks locally against a dev server or local process.

options.label: CI/CD pipeline
options.description: Hooks fire as part of an automated build or deploy pipeline.

options.label: Staging
options.description: Hooks are wired up in a staging environment that mirrors production.

options.label: Production
options.description: Testing live hooks in the production environment.

questions.question: What type of hook event are you primarily testing?

options.label: Pre-commit / pre-push
options.description: Git hooks that run before a commit or push completes.

options.label: Webhook (HTTP)
options.description: An outbound HTTP callback triggered by some event.

options.label: Tool-call hook
options.description: Claude Code hooks that intercept tool calls (e.g. user-prompt-submit-hook).

options.label: Post-merge / CI trigger
options.description: Hooks that fire after a merge or as a CI step.

questions.question: What is the primary failure mode you're trying to catch?

options.label: Hook not firing at all
options.description: The hook doesn't trigger when it should.

options.label: Wrong payload / data
options.description: The hook fires but the data it receives or emits is incorrect.

options.label: Timing / ordering issue
options.description: The hook fires too early, too late, or out of order.

options.label: Auth / permissions failure
options.description: The hook fires but is rejected due to missing or wrong credentials.

questions.question: How mature is the hook integration you're testing?

options.label: Brand new
options.description: First time wiring this hook up — still figuring out the basics.

options.label: Existing, recently changed
options.description: The hook worked before; something was modified and you're verifying it still works.

options.label: Regression check
options.description: No changes were made; you're confirming nothing broke.

answers.What is the primary failure mode you're: Wrong payload / data, This is 'something else' checked and manually filled.
answers.How mature is the hook integration you'r: Pretty good. One more multi-select please. Also one with code snippets. Need to test those, too.
